card.title: Siddharth's Thesis Defense Seminar
card.subtitle: Exploring Viral Diversity for In Vivo Delivery of Genetic Medicine
lines: I will be defending my thesis on Tuesday, September 29th, 2026.
Public Defense Seminar: 3:30 PM to 4:30 PM.
In-person location: Cortex Room at 201 Brookline Ave, Boston, Massachusetts.
There is also a zoom link if you cannot make it in person.
I would love to see you there and share my work of the last five years with you.
card.footer: After the private section of the defense, there will be refreshments in the penthouse.
